task: ae.broker: MQTT-style pub/sub broker core (wildcard trie, retained, wills, QoS1 redelivery, sessions) verified by literal, differential, simulation and mutation tests
reasoning_summary: Split the broker into a pure topic matcher, a pruning subscription trie and a session/QoS state machine with an injected clock. Tests were written first: literal tables, a trie-vs-reference differential, and a seeded simulation that runs an invariant checker after every step against an exactly-once-after-ack, in-order oracle. A 16-mutant check killed 15; the survivor is equivalent.
